# Wire UI

> AI-native unstyled primitives framework. Headless, compound components with AI-integrated docs. Zero CSS — style via data-* attributes.

Wire UI provides AI-native, headless compound components for React, Vue, and SolidJS. Every component handles interaction states, accessibility, and complex behaviors while shipping zero CSS. Style them with Tailwind, CSS Modules, plain CSS — anything that supports attribute selectors. The same building blocks the components are made from are exported as hooks (React), composables (Vue), and primitives (Solid, named `createX`).

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs): Overview, core principles, and philosophy
- [Getting Started](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/getting-started): Installation, styling approach, validation pattern, TypeScript types
- [Accessibility](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/accessibility): ARIA roles, focus management, and keyboard support
- [Data Attributes](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/data-attributes): Complete reference for all data-* attributes Wire UI exposes
- [Browser Support](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/browser-support): Supported browser matrix
- [FAQ](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/faq): Common questions

## AI for Agents

- [LLMs.txt](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai/llms-txt): AI-readable documentation index and full-text reference
- [SKILL.md](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai/skill-md): Machine-readable docs with decision trees and anti-patterns
- [MCP Server](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/ai/mcp): `@wire-ui/mcp` — direct API access for AI coding tools

## Components

### Layout

- [Accordion](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/accordion): Collapsible sections with single or multiple selection types
- [AspectRatio](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/aspect-ratio): Maintains a width-to-height ratio for its child via CSS aspect-ratio
- [Card](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/card): Unstyled container with optional data-color and data-size attributes
- [Divider](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/divider): Horizontal or vertical separator line
- [List](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/list): Ordered or unordered list with optional striped rows and dividers
- [ResizablePanels](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/resizable-panels): Drag-to-resize panel layout with min/max constraints
- [Skeleton](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/skeleton): Accessible loading placeholder that swaps in real content when ready

### Feedback

- [Alert](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/alert): Dismissible alert with auto-dismiss support
- [Badge](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/badge): Numeric count badge capped at 9+
- [ProgressBar](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/progress-bar): Accessible progress indicator with role="progressbar" and ARIA attributes
- [Rating](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/rating): Star rating with hover preview, read-only, and disabled modes
- [Spinner](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/spinner): Accessible loading indicator with role=status and a visually-hidden label

### Forms

- [Button](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/button): Native button with full interactive state tracking and asChild polymorphism
- [Calendar](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/calendar): Headless month calendar with controlled selection, min/max dates, and a render-prop grid
- [Checkbox](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/checkbox): Multi-select checkbox group with controlled state
- [Combobox](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/combobox): Filterable autocomplete with keyboard navigation and ARIA listbox semantics
- [DatePicker](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/date-picker): Trigger plus popover Calendar with a formatted value display
- [FileUpload](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/file-upload): Click-to-pick or drag-and-drop file upload with built-in accept, maxFiles, and maxSize validation
- [Form](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/form): Headless form primitives that wire id, ARIA, and validation attributes onto your own controls
- [Input](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/input): Compound text input with consumer-controlled error state
- [NumberInput](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/number-input): Numeric input with increment/decrement controls, clamping, and full keyboard support
- [OTP](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/otp): One-time password input with individual slots, auto-advance, and onComplete callback
- [Password](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/password): Password input with a built-in show/hide toggle and consumer-controlled error state
- [Radio](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/radio): Single-selection radio group
- [Select](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/select): Accessible select menu with groups, separators, and a custom trigger
- [Slider](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/slider): Single-value or two-thumb range slider with drag and keyboard support (React only)
- [Switch](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/switch): Toggle on/off with a thumb element and data-state
- [Tag](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tag): Compact label with optional remove button — for chips, filters, and status pills
- [TagInput](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tag-input): Multi-tag input with commit keys, duplicate rejection, and validation
- [Textarea](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/textarea): Compound multi-line text input with consumer-controlled error state

### Navigation

- [Breadcrumb](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/breadcrumb): Semantic navigation trail with current-page marking and a customizable separator
- [MenuBar](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/menu-bar): Application-style menu bar with hover-switching dropdowns
- [NavigationMenu](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/navigation-menu): Top navigation with hover-driven dropdown panels
- [Pagination](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/pagination): Page navigation with sibling/boundary pages and ellipsis gaps
- [Tabs](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tabs): Accessible tabs with horizontal or vertical orientation and full keyboard navigation (React only)
- [TreeView](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tree-view): Recursive tree with expandable branches, optional single or multi selection, and full keyboard navigation

### Overlays

- [ContextMenu](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/context-menu): Right-click menu positioned at the cursor
- [Drawer](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/drawer): Side-panel overlay with portal rendering and close behaviours
- [Dropdown](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/dropdown): Trigger and menu pattern with keyboard and click-outside support
- [Modal](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/modal): Dialog with portal rendering, overlay-click and Escape key close
- [Popover](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/popover): Floating panel anchored to a trigger. Closes on outside click or Escape (React only)
- [Search](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/search): Search input with dropdown results, keyboard navigation, and loading state
- [Toast](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/toast): Imperative notification system with a Provider, Viewport render-prop, and useToast hook
- [Tooltip](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/tooltip): Hover/focus tooltip with configurable delay and side

### Media

- [Avatar](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/avatar): Image with a fallback for loading errors or missing sources
- [Icon](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/icon): Renders consumer-supplied SVG strings by name. Ships no SVG assets
- [Image](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/image): Image wrapper with a loader placeholder shown until the image loads
- [Timeago](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/components/timeago): Relative or formatted timestamp that updates live

## Hooks / Composables / Primitives

React and Vue expose these as `useX`; Solid follows its `createX` naming convention.

### State

- [useControllableState](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-controllable-state): Unified state for components that can be controlled or uncontrolled
- [useDisclosure](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-disclosure): Boolean open / close state with stable open, close, and toggle handlers
- [useId](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-id): Stable, SSR-safe unique id with an optional human-readable prefix
- [usePrevious](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-previous): Returns the value from the previous render
- [useStateMachine](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-state-machine): Typed finite state machine with state / send / can / transitions
- [useUndoRedo](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-undo-redo): State container with bounded undo / redo history

### Interaction

- [useClickOutside](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-click-outside): Fires a callback when the user clicks or taps outside a referenced element
- [useFocusTrap](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-focus-trap): Trap keyboard focus inside a container while active
- [useFocusVisible](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-focus-visible): Track whether focus arrived from keyboard navigation or a pointer
- [useInteractiveState](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-interactive-state): Hover, focus-visible, and press state tracking with matching data attributes
- [useKeyboard](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-keyboard): Map keyboard events to handlers with modifier-key matching
- [useHotkeys](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-hotkeys): Declarative shortcut binder with mod+k combos, scopes, and input-suppression
- [useLongPress](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-long-press): Long-press gesture handler with move-cancel and threshold
- [useCopyToClipboard](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-copy-to-clipboard): Async clipboard write with a copied flag and auto-reset

### Layout

- [useFloating](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-floating): Position a floating element relative to a reference element
- [useScrollLock](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-scroll-lock): Lock document scrolling while active, without layout shift

### Observers

- [useIntersectionObserver](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-intersection-observer): Observe element visibility within a scroll container or the viewport
- [useResizeObserver](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-resize-observer): Observe an element's content-box dimensions
- [useMutationObserver](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-mutation-observer): Observe DOM mutations on a ref target
- [useElementSize](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-element-size): Live content-box width and height of a referenced element
- [useWindowSize](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-window-size): Live width and height of the viewport

### Timing

- [useTimeout](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-timeout): setTimeout wrapper with start / stop / reset and isPending
- [useInterval](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-interval): setInterval wrapper with pause / resume / reset — null delay pauses
- [useDebounce](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-debounce): Debounce a reactive value or a callback function
- [useThrottle](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-throttle): Throttle a reactive value or a callback function

### Storage

- [useLocalStorage / useSessionStorage](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-local-storage): SSR-safe useState-shaped hook backed by Web Storage with cross-tab sync

### DOM

- [useEventListener](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-event-listener): Typed addEventListener for window / document / element / ref
- [useDocumentVisibility](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-document-visibility): Reactive document.visibilityState
- [useOnlineStatus](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-online-status): Reactive navigator.onLine boolean
- [useMediaQuery](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-media-query): Reactively match a CSS media query
- [useReduceMotion](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-reduce-motion): Detect the OS-level reduced-motion preference
- [useIsomorphicLayoutEffect](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect): useLayoutEffect on the client, useEffect on the server (React only)

### Utilities

- [useMergedRefs](https://wire-ui.vercel.app/docs/hooks/use-merged-refs): Merge multiple refs onto a single element (React and Solid)
